additions.label: ESI-32
additions.description: Records microphone or audio-interface input and loads local audio into eight sample slots, with waveform trimming, forward loops, reverse playback, envelopes and a resonant lowpass. Original demo samples, pitched keyboard and MIDI, and portable sample banks.
additions.start: Enable Audio, hold a keyboard key or Audition, then drag waveform markers to trim or loop. Select a slot to load your own sound.
